bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}}' | grep -E 'bot-api|telegram|createvdobot|videobot' | head -25 || true
docker inspect gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Destination .Type}}{{end}}'
for root in /mnt/g /mnt/G /mnt/gdrive /media/g /home/gace/Project/Gserver; do
 if test -d "$root"; then
  echo "SCAN_ROOT_PRESENT=$(basename "$root")"
  find "$root" -maxdepth 5 -type f -size +1300M -size -1900M -printf '%s %p\n' 2>/dev/null | head -6 | sed -E 's#(.*/)[^/]+$#\1[media filename redacted]#'
 fi
done
